## D — Defensive driving, attention and fatigue
Accuracy boundary: Defensive driving, attention and fatigue uses only the selected physical Idaho handbook pages, with one claim and one page per fact block.
Scanning time is approximate guidance, not a fixed stopping interval. Phone penalties and exemptions are withheld pending current official legal evidence. Source statistics are not converted into universal causal estimates. Freeway exit instructions on the first mapped page remain in scope.
Commercial licensing, motorcycle permits and unrelated paragraphs on mixed pages are outside the assigned passenger-car scope. No diagram has been converted into an invented verbal rule.

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.
